description: Subagents handoff pipeline for collaborative feature delivery with explicit context bridging.

agents.task: Define the subagent handoff contract for a new observability feature: required summary template, ownership boundaries, and quality gates between phases.
As subagent B, read the handoff contract and design collector-side stream processing changes for the feature, including analyzers and event schema deltas.
As subagent C, consume prior summaries and propose dashboard updates to visualize new events, with timeline and drill-down interactions.
As subagent D, define end-to-end verification for the full handoff chain and ensure each subagent output can be validated in sequence.
